protocol: Native MTP K-stop on native MTP K2 async: three added environment keys (switch off by default, control path, uniform-batch policy off); with the switch on the launcher selects K3, capture sizes [1, 4, 16] and one of two memory-admitted KV layouts, and requires the short-context DSA shortcut off

RECIPE_MAX_MODEL_LEN=44224.status: UNMEASURED: holds only if NCCL without LL128 frees the ledger's 0.44 GiB; measure that first

refused: capture sizes 1..16 at 693 blocks (predicted rank 0 7.82 [7.72, 7.90] GiB, under the 8.0 launcher floor): no switch combination produces it

requires: GLM_INDEXER_SHORTCUT=0 (both transform the pinned runner, autoregressive speculator and graph manager sources; refused by the launcher and at startup)
native MTP, greedy drafts, standard rejection, async scheduling, TP4, block 64, at most 4 slots, FULL_DECODE_ONLY, modular Marlin MoE

policy.rule: pass 1 always; pass 2 iff p1 >= tau; pass 3 iff p1*p2 >= tau; a low score keeps the token just computed
policy.tau_source: selected by equal-weight mean projected gain on a training split of saved teacher-forced native MTP proposals, with assumed costs K2 79.6 ms, K3 91.2 ms and 11.75 ms credit per skipped position (4.75 ms MTP pass + 7 ms verify row)
policy.tau_refit: tau should be refit once the per-position skip cost is measured on the fleet; window 4 measured the native K2 c1 cycle at 80-81 ms, the K3 and skip costs are unmeasured

projected_c1_gain_percent.note: held-out classes, point and paired 95 % prompt interval; conditional arithmetic on the assumed costs, not a measurement

control.mode: local only: every rank decides from its own copy of the all-gathered MTP logits; broadcast control is refused outside offline CPU tests
control.guard: before the target forward and each further MTP pass, one fixed 13 x int64 (104 B) PyNccl MAX all-reduce carries 124 bits of a running SHA-256 of the decision inputs, the exact FP32 bits of the probabilities and a local-refusal flag; the flag rides the existing planner D2H copy and a mismatch raises the same error on every rank at the same host point
control.guard_cost: isolated fleet canary: about 96 us per reduction (1 per K2-shaped cycle, 2-3 per K3-stop cycle); serving-path cost unmeasured

not_shipped: GPU correctness gate, canary, coordinator, window, cycle receipts and A/B switch RPC (campaign harness, not in the served path)
deterministic MoE alignment overlay (separate, default off, not part of this switch)

overlay/kstop/glm_mtp_kstop.py.change: reviewed packet code plus the default-off GLM_MTP_KSTOP_UNIFORM_BATCH policy; with the flag off every code path, fold and agreement payload is the packet's

overlay/kstop/kstop_runtime.py.change: reviewed packet code plus the default-off GLM_MTP_KSTOP_UNIFORM_BATCH policy; with the flag off every code path, fold and agreement payload is the packet's

code_identity: kstop_policy.py, deadrow_ops.py and source_pins.json are the reviewed fix12/fix13 packet files. glm_mtp_kstop.py adds one value check of GLM_MTP_KSTOP_UNIFORM_BATCH at registration; kstop_runtime.py adds the default-off uniform-batch policy and differs in one docstring credit line. control.json is new (the packet's harness wrote the control file).

evidence_to_date.cpu: campaign packet: 232 CPU tests in the pinned image (fix13); this repository: tests/test_kstop.py, launcher and startup tests, pinned-image composed startup
fleet: guard canary PASS in five windows (symmetric refusal, dead-rank self-abort, recovery)
native K2 control layout booted, warmed and admitted (rank 0 post-warm 9.62-10.16 GiB in the one-slot layout)
native correctness gate: PASS 13/13 once, FAIL on run-to-run numerics twice; screen mode now separates hard safety checks
the K3-stop layout itself has never booted on the fleet; no speed or quality result exists

status: staged, default off until a fleet speed screen and a qualification pass

graph_descriptors.source: pinned vLLM 487ecf187 CudaGraphManager._init_candidates/dispatch after the overlay transform (decode_query_lens [2,3,4])

dispatch.c1: every shape exact (target/first M2, M3, M4; later M1)
dispatch.c2: q2, q3 exact; q4 pads to M16; later pads to M4
dispatch.c3: q4 pads to M16, later to M4; uniform q2/q3 eager
dispatch.c4: q4 exact M16, later exact M4; uniform q2/q3 eager
dispatch.heterogeneous: verify rectangles where requests drafted different lengths run the target eager in every layout (dead-row remap is not captured)

uniform_batch.rule: with more than one request in the draft batch every request drafts all three tokens (no stop decision, no decision guard, no confidence read); one request keeps the confidence stop
uniform_batch.why: heterogeneous verify rectangles run the target eager; with [1, 4, 16] only q4 replays a graph at c3/c4, so a common K of 3 is the only common K that never falls back to eager
uniform_batch.rank_identity: depends only on num_reqs (bound by the begin fold and the prepare guard); the flag is bound by the cold control agreement
uniform_batch.status: unmeasured; c4 screen spec in the campaign packet
